create_siren_network: create a SIREN neural network with sine activations and custom layer widths for continuous representation learning
build_basis_smearing: build a Basis module with powersine or gauss smearing to encode input features into higher dimensional space
create_fourier_smearing: create a FourierSmearing module to apply sine or cosine frequency encoding to input tensor features
build_spherical_smearing: build a SphericalSmearing module to compute spherical harmonics from normalized 3D coordinate vectors
create_gaussian_smearing: create a GaussianSmearing module to apply Gaussian basis function expansion to input features
